scripts.features: Auto Hit every lucky block open source
scripts.script:
while wait(0.2) do
local luckyBlocks = workspace:WaitForChild("LuckyBlocks")

for _, block in pairs(luckyBlocks:GetChildren()) do
    local args = { block }
    game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("DamageBlockEvent"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end
end
